## Activity

During June 2019, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 389 captures. This represents the recorded activity for the reporting month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance. The activity should continue to be monitored through routine operational reporting, with any recurring camera issues logged with the service desk for follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the 389 captures, 20 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.1 per cent. This measure should be reviewed alongside local equipment and operating issues to identify opportunities to improve the proportion of images suitable for grading. Recurring camera issues should be recorded with the service desk so that they can be assessed and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 62 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides an indication of the usual time between image capture and completion of grading during June 2019. Continued review of grading activity, image quality and operational delays will support consistent service monitoring at West Gate Eye Clinic.
